name: zeffect_handle_attach_event
description: zEffect::HandleAttachEvent optionally resets a target display instance variant and applies the requested variant index.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native attach event tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x45b440 validates null guards, non-negative target-ref gate, target node lookup, optional ResetCurrentVariant on flag bit 0 when the display instance exists, SetCurrentVariant with signed variant index, and return 2.
The native parent/attach/detach smoke verifies reset-plus-set behavior against a two-frame display-instance material cycle.
